interpretation: 329 direct endpoint cell/batch FREE contradictions become UNKNOWN/OCCUPIED; 21 are the seven actor entry cells repeated over the first three accepted entry batches.
Current whole-cell false FREE is not eliminated: positive endpoint evidence does not fill or erase hidden prior FREE interiors. Residual boundary and whole-cell strata remain explicit.

Earlier confidence can transiently increase false OCCUPIED center counts. Strict whole-clear false OCCUPIED includes two pre-existing actor top-boundary cells recognized four records earlier; their physical gap is only about 2.384 nm, with no new spatial footprint.
Occlusion preserves only previously observed cells until the configured five-second TTL; expiry is UNKNOWN, not FREE. Global fresh observations do not refresh hidden cell history.

Reference scores are fixture-local, exclude declared incomplete robot/background regions, and require agreement across the two exposure poses; they do not certify unsampled workspace, continuous free volume, or robot motion safety.
The 56-record data-collection timeline includes scoring and I/O. Its actual intervals are not a clean 2 Hz or latency benchmark; source/integration times are original.

capture_timeline.purpose: Original instrumented capture chronology only; use the separate clean benchmark for cadence and latency.

earlier_occupancy_tradeoff.explanation: The same two top-boundary endpoint cells become OCCUPIED at record 17 rather than 21; other transient center/ghost strata are retained in phase totals.

moving_robot_filter_stratum.reference: Independent instance IDs on the original selected pixels; labels never enter production.

limited_final_fixture_domain_subset.definition: Historical robot-return centers in the final scored fixture domain, outside declared robot exclusions and with no fixture-cell overlap.

limitations: Historical robot-return occupancy in the environment layer is not automatically a ghost: cells may overlap the current robot, another surface, or an incompletely referenced region.

Complete exposure robot meshes/bounds were not exported globally. The native robot exclusions are center-based and fixture-local; the limited subset does not certify a whole cell is clear of the current robot.

Selected-return mask retention does not establish dense silhouette removal or continuous robot clearance. Automatic filtering can intentionally withhold depth-ambiguous external surfaces; actor withheld counts are explicit.
